findings.reason: Step 3.1 defines W_{k+1}=Z_{k+1}+S_{k+1} but establishes only E[S_k|F_k]=S_k, which does not establish the supermartingale inequality for W. Show S_{k+1}=S_k+b_k/A_{k+1} is F_k-measurable by predictability, and include its conditional expectation so the new term cancels the decrement before applying Doob.

The proof conditions on F_k and treats x_k as known but does not establish that the projected iterates are F_k-measurable. Add the induction from deterministic x_0 using G_k being F_{k+1}-measurable and continuity of P_C, supplied by the projection and proximal-map results.
The example invokes a conditional bias and variance theorem without specifying its filtered probability model. State, for example, a one-point probability space with trivial filtration.
The title says the iterate stops away from the minimizer, but the example permits b=0. Retitle to reflect the limit b^2 for all b, or qualify the away-from-minimizer claim with b≠0.
